description: The profile of the Content-Type, on every request (without content too), must be listed in the Accept: 400 with RPP-Code 02001. A Content-Type without parameters is the default profile of the server (core 14.3).
comment: Skipped on epp-docker: the EPP config signals the profile by the RPP-Profile header; profile_signalling_header/ covers the header method.

steps.comment: Reads the discovery document, with Content-Type application/rpp+json; profile="urn:ietf:params:rpp:profile:base"; profile-version="1.0", Accept application/rpp+json; profile="urn:ietf:params:rpp:profile:epp-compatibility"; profile-version="1.0"; expects 400 02001. An error answer this case checks. Only where the default profile is epp (epp-docker).

Reads the discovery document, with Content-Type application/rpp+json, Accept application/rpp+json; profile="urn:ietf:params:rpp:profile:base"; profile-version="1.0"; expects 400 02001. An error answer this case checks. Only where the default profile is epp (epp-docker).

Reads the discovery document, with Content-Type application/rpp+json; profile="urn:ietf:params:rpp:profile:base"; profile-version="1.0", Accept application/rpp+json; profile="de.denic.rpp.profile.rri"; profile-version="1.0"; expects 400 02001. An error answer this case checks. Only where the default profile is rri (rri-mtest).

Reads the discovery document, with Content-Type application/rpp+json, Accept application/rpp+json; profile="urn:ietf:params:rpp:profile:base"; profile-version="1.0"; expects 400 02001. An error answer this case checks. Only where the default profile is rri (rri-mtest).

Creates contact PB4, with Content-Type application/rpp+json, Accept application/rpp+json; profile="urn:ietf:params:rpp:profile:base"; profile-version="1.0"; expects 400 02001. The error answer this case checks.
